strategy_description: Hold SPY when the lagged SLOOS-tightening signal is favorable (easy credit); else cash.
lead_description: Signal is lagged 2 quarter(s) before allocation.
notes: SLOOS C&I net-% tightening for large and middle-market firms (DRTSCILM) is a QUARTERLY credit survey that historically leads equity weakness by 1-4 quarters. Net-% is bounded/mean-reverting. Winner (level) is selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window (1999-12-31 to 2017-09-30, 72q) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window (32q); still a search-selected rule.

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) quarterly mean/std*sqrt(4); winner evaluated on OOS window

is_window.rule: common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date across all grid candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: Pre-GH#251 OOS-argmax selection, comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261015.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only
